name: TrayZero
tagline: A private task manager that keeps your to-dos on your device
description:
TrayZero is a task manager built around the Getting Things Done (GTD) method, with everything kept on your own device. There's no account to sign up for and nothing gets sent to a server.

It's free and open source, made for people who want a serious task manager without handing their to-do list over to a company.
